## 简体中文

- 文件树和文件标签页采用 Material Icon Theme 彩色图标，区分 Python、Jupyter、JavaScript/TypeScript、C/C++、Rust、Go、Shell、JSON/YAML、图片、日志、压缩包等常见文件类型。
- 文件夹图标区分展开和折叠状态，源码、图片、文档及配置目录提供对应图标；新建和重命名时根据名称自动更新，未知类型使用通用文件图标。
- 按需内置 41 个 SVG，原始文件合计约 19 KiB，无需额外依赖包或联网加载。发行包同步包含图标来源与 MIT 许可证。

## English

- Use colorful Material Icon Theme icons in the file tree and open tabs to distinguish common types, including Python, Jupyter, JavaScript/TypeScript, C/C++, Rust, Go, Shell, JSON/YAML, images, logs and archives.
- Distinguish expanded and collapsed folders, with dedicated icons for source, image, documentation and configuration directories. Icons update while creating or renaming files; unknown types use a generic file icon.
- Bundle only 41 SVGs, totaling about 19 KiB before compression, without adding a dependency package or requiring network access. Release packages include the icon attribution and MIT license.
